# Sparkly Space Cleaning Services

> Top-rated professional domestic, deep-cleaning, end-of-tenancy, Airbnb, and commercial cleaning services across Bournemouth, Poole, and Christchurch in Dorset, UK.

## Overview
Sparkly Space Cleaning Services provides tailored cleaning solutions for residential homes, holiday rentals, offices, and end-of-tenancy turnarounds. Every quote is custom-calculated based on property size, condition, location, and specific requirements to ensure accuracy and fairness.

## Key Services
- **Residential & Domestic Cleaning**: Regular weekly or fortnightly home cleaning tailored to client routines.
- **Deep Cleaning**: Intensive top-to-bottom refresh targeting limescale, built-up dust, white goods, and hard-to-reach areas.
- **End of Tenancy Cleaning**: Agency-approved checkout deep cleaning designed to secure 100% deposit returns.
- **Airbnb & Holiday Let Cleaning**: Fast-turnaround turnover cleaning, linen laundering, restocking guest amenities, key exchange coordination, and property condition reporting.
- **Commercial & Office Cleaning**: Flexible scheduled sanitization for offices, retail units, and commercial premises across Dorset.
- **Eco-Conscious Cleaning**: Optional non-toxic, child-safe, and pet-friendly cleaning products upon request.

## Service Area & Coverage
- **Primary Locations**: Bournemouth, Poole, Christchurch, Wimborne, Ferndown, and Purbeck.
- **Postcode Coverage**: All Dorset BH postcodes (BH1, BH2, BH3, BH4, BH5, BH6, BH7, BH8, BH9, BH10, BH11, BH12, BH13, BH14, BH15, BH16, BH17, BH18, BH19, BH20, BH21, BH22, BH23).

## Key Facts & Trust Signals
- **Satisfaction Guarantee**: 100% Spotless Guarantee with free re-clean within 24 hours if any detail is missed.
- **Vetted Staff**: Fully background-checked, insured, and professionally trained cleaners.
- **Average Rating**: 4.9 out of 5 stars based on customer feedback.
